findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "docs" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pdf_to_images, pdf_protect, html_to_pdf · Private data: extract_pdf, ocr_image, pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_extract_pages, pdf_remove_pages, pdf_rotate, pdf_compress, pdf_to_images, images_to_pdf, pdf_watermark, pdf_page_numbers, pdf_protect, pdf_unlock, pdf_metadata, html_to_pdf, pdf_ocr · Public sink: pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_extract_pages, pdf_remove_pages, pdf_rotate, pdf_compress, pdf_watermark, pdf_page_numbers, pdf_protect, pdf_unlock, pdf_metadata, pdf_ocr · Destructive: ocr_image, pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_extract_pages, pdf_remove_pages, pdf_rotate, pdf_to_images, pdf_watermark, pdf_page_numbers, pdf_protect, pdf_unlock, pdf_metadata.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pdf_to_images, pdf_protect, html_to_pdf · Private data: extract_pdf, ocr_image, pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_extract_pages, pdf_remove_pages, pdf_rotate, pdf_compress, pdf_to_images, images_to_pdf, pdf_watermark, pdf_page_numbers, pdf_protect, pdf_unlock, pdf_metadata, html_to_pdf, pdf_ocr · Public sink: pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_extract_pages, pdf_remove_pages, pdf_rotate, pdf_compress, pdf_watermark, pdf_page_numbers, pdf_protect, pdf_unlock, pdf_metadata, pdf_ocr · Destructive: ocr_image, pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_extract_pages, pdf_remove_pages, pdf_rotate, pdf_to_images, pdf_watermark, pdf_page_numbers, pdf_protect, pdf_unlock, pdf_metadata

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
